name: Saccharomyces spp.
aliases: including S. cerevisiae / boulardii-associated invasive infection

syndromes.title: Invasive infection
rows: Use organism-specific recommendations and source control as presented in the 2021 rare-yeast guideline
First-line L-AmB 3–5 mg/kg/day; alternatives in pathway: caspofungin 70 mg day 1 → 50 mg/day, micafungin 100 mg/day, fluconazole 200–400 mg/day
Assess weekly after last negative blood culture; duration individualized
Chen 2021 Rare Yeast Suppl | Fig 23 | PDF p143
Individualize by response, site, susceptibility and source control
Comparative randomized trials are generally unavailable; treatment must follow species identification and susceptibility.

audit_summary.visual_status: All SVGs are summary reconstructions; original guideline figure remains definitive
